messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the PM: we're still getting noisy API rate-limit alerts during traffic dips. Need a concrete plan for waveform-aware thresholds + dedupe so we don't page on benign retries.

nora: saw spikes on the rate-limiter metric last night but most were client bursts that auto-recovered. Pages woke someone at 02:15. definitely noisy.

rachel: proposal: switch to an adaptive threshold that scales with 5m baseline traffic per cluster. if requests/min < 1000, raise threshold multiplier x3; else use normal sensitivity.

diego: also add dedupe key = client_id + endpoint + error_code to avoid duplicate pages from many instances hitting same upstream. set dedupe window to 20m by default.

alex: i like the adaptive idea. we should still page if SLO error ratio > 0.5% in the last 1m (so a relative signal can override the adaptive mute).

ops-bot: Note: runbook updated by @rachel -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/api-rate-limiter

rachel: quick config sketch i tested in staging: ```yaml
alert: ApiRateLimiterHigh
expr: (
  sum(rate(api_rate_limited[1m])) by (cluster)
  > (baseline_requests_per_minute * 0.02) * threshold_multiplier
)
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: p2
annotations:
  summary: "High rate limiter triggered ({{ $labels.cluster }})"
```
We'll compute baseline_requests_per_minute from a moving 1h median. threshold_multiplier = if baseline < 1000 then 3 else 1.

nora: timeline suggestion: - RFC w/ exact multiplier and SLO override by EOD Wed - rule PR by Fri - deploy to staging Mon - 72h observation window - prod rollout Thu. Owners: rachel (RFC & PR), diego (dedupe logic + tests), alex (SLO override + rollback plan).

diego: i'll add unit tests for dedupe key generation and a small script to replay historical alerts to verify reduction.

alex: add a dashboard tile that shows pre/post alert counts and dedupe closes to validate. include a per-endpoint breakdown.

rachel: will add the dashboard and a short note in the runbook about when to bypass adaptive thresholds (e.g., planned load-tests).

ops-bot: @channel On-call this week -> Fri: @rachel, Sat: @diego, Sun: @nora.

nora: small question: what's our recovery window for the dedupe auto-close? diego suggested 20m but if an error persists longer we want repeated escalation.

diego: plan: dedupe window 20m for non-prod, 10m for prod, and auto-reopen if error rate increases by >2x after the dedupe window ends.

alex: sounds good. add a short-runbook step to manually escalate if retries are from an internal service (high blast radius).

rachel: action items recap: rachel -> PR + dashboard + runbook notes; diego -> dedupe code + replay test; alex -> SLO override and escalation guidance; nora -> monitor post-deploy and validate pages. target: RFC by EOD Wed.

diego: i'll kick off the replay job tomorrow and post a short summary with expected reduction numbers.

alex: thanks team. reconvene next Thu 9:30am after prod rollout for a quick tally and any rollbacks. :thumbsup:

rachel: ACK, will schedule calendar.

ops-bot: Automated note: RFC document created -> https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/adaptive-rate-limiter-alerting

nora: appreciate the quick turnaround on this. hopefully fewer 2am pages. :coffee:

diego: me too. i'll post the replay results when ready.```
